description_en: Queries the used anti-ransomware storage capacity
description_zh: 查询已使用的防勒索存储容量
name: GetBackupStorageCount

BackupStorageCount.description_en: The details of the anti-ransomware storage capacity
BackupStorageCount.description_zh: 防勒索存储容量的详情

BuyStorageByte.description_en: The purchased anti-ransomware capacity. Unit: bytes
BuyStorageByte.description_zh: 已购买的防勒索容量。单位为Byte

EcsUsageStorageByte.description_en: The storage capacity occupied by server backups in the backup data. Unit: bytes
EcsUsageStorageByte.description_zh: 备份数据中，服务器备份已占用的存储容量。单位为Byte

Overflow.description_en:
Indicates whether the anti-ransomware usage exceeds the purchased capacity. Valid values:

0: not exceeded
1: exceeded
Overflow.description_zh:
防勒索使用量是否超过已购买的容量。取值：

0：未超过
1：已超过

UniUsageStorageByte.description_en: The storage capacity occupied by database backups in the backup data. Unit: bytes
UniUsageStorageByte.description_zh: 备份数据中，数据库备份已占用的存储容量。单位为Byte

UsageStorageByte.description_en: The total used anti-ransomware storage capacity. Unit: bytes
UsageStorageByte.description_zh: 已使用的防勒索存储总容量。单位为Byte

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
